rationale: The badge image shows the text "-50%", and the sentence after it ("on all seeds this week") makes no sense without it. Its empty alt hides information that nothing else on the page gives.
The SVG is a single grey horizontal line used as a divider, so hiding it with aria-hidden loses nothing.
The alt text "IMG_2041.jpg" is a file name and says nothing about what the product photo shows, and no description is linked to the image.
The alt "Canvas garden bag with two leather handles" describes the product and fits its list item, which is headed "Garden bag".
"Demo Shop" in the header is the site name or logo text before the navigation. It is not a title for a section of text.
"Delivery" titles the paragraph about delivery times that follows it, but it is a bold paragraph rather than a heading.
The title "Page" is generic. It does not say that the page is about garden tools and does not set it apart from the site's other pages.
"Learn more" sits alone in its own paragraph, and nothing around it says that it leads to the products page or what you would learn there.
"Postcode" is given only by the title tooltip. No visible text sits next to the field, and the "Check delivery" button comes after a different field and does not say what to enter.
Only a placeholder says "Name", and it disappears once the field is filled in. No visible label or nearby text stays on screen.
"Demo Shop" is the site name in the header, followed by the navigation and an account menu. It does not title the text after it.
The title "Offers - Demo Shop" matches the page's only heading, "Offers", and says what the page is about.
Three mouse-usable controls never take focus: the Account menu span with a click handler, the Fern tile div with a click handler and the Cactus span with role button.
The Account menu span has a click handler but can never take focus, and none of the 7 Tab stops offers the same account menu action.
The Cactus tile has role button but cannot take focus, and Tab never reaches it.
The first Tab stop is the "Seeds and bulbs" link far down the main content (y=850), before the header navigation and the earlier main links. This order does not follow the reading order.
Home is Tab stop 2, but nothing changed when it had focus (changesOnFocus is empty and 0 pixels changed), so focus is invisible.
Products is Tab stop 3, but nothing changed when it had focus (changesOnFocus is empty and 0 pixels changed), so focus is invisible.
Cart is Tab stop 4, but nothing changed when it had focus (changesOnFocus is empty and 0 pixels changed), so focus is invisible.
Focus is invisible on the three navigation links, where nothing changed, and on the Roses and Tulips links, which were entirely covered by the sticky header while focused.
The sticky header entirely covers stops 5 and 6, "Roses, 20% off" and "Tulips, 3 for 2" (coveredShare 1), while they have focus.
The sticky header entirely covers stops 5 and 6 (coveredShare 1) while they have focus, so it fails the enhanced criterion too.
